title: Alarm Handling
source_reference: 大作业题库json/大作业题库.json, easy[2]
requirements: Implement an alarm management function block with hysteresis. When Value is greater than hiLevel, set hiAlarm. Clear hiAlarm only when Value is less than hiLevel - hystWindow. When Value is less than loLevel, set loAlarm. Clear loAlarm only when Value is greater than loLevel + hystWindow. If loLevel is greater than or equal to hiLevel, set error to TRUE and status to 16#8001, then skip normal alarm processing for that invocation. If hystWindow is greater than or equal to hiLevel - loLevel, set error to TRUE and status to 16#8002, then skip normal alarm processing for that invocation. When the configuration is valid, set error to FALSE and status to 16#0000.

interface.name: error
interface.description: TRUE when the configuration is invalid

interface.name: status
interface.description: 16#0000 for valid configuration, 16#8001 for loLevel >= hiLevel, or 16#8002 for an excessive hysteresis window

notes: Converted from the teacher-provided public task and reviewed against the frozen specification and tests.
The source omits an explicit success status; 16#0000 is frozen as the shared success convention.
